**Finding: compliant** (preferred position met)

The agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-poaching covenant of any kind. I confirmed this by searching for "solicit", "hire", "employ", "induce", and "recruit", and by reading the three candidate locations:

- **§ 13 (Shared Resources)** — governs access to Commerce One operations/consulting/engineering personnel, Developments ownership, and Employee NDA/Invention Agreement warranties, but imposes no hiring restraint on Corio.
- **§ 14 (Miscellaneous)** — assignment, waiver, governing law/arbitration, notices, independent contractors, severability, force majeure, subcontracting, bankruptcy, entire agreement; no restrictive covenant.
- **Exhibit D § 5 (Personnel)** — only a mutual staffing commitment to dedicate one sales/marketing employee each.

Because the playbook's preferred position is "no non-solicit on Customer," the absence of such a clause is the best outcome for us rather than a gap — so this is recorded as compliant with no redline proposed.
